sources.economyRules: 第一章30锚点关卡生成配置-v0.1.json

rules: M01 and M02 cannot both be non-combat.
No optional elite may be assigned to M01-M07.
At least one optional elite is assigned in M08-M18 and one in M20-M27.
One Shop is assigned in M08-M18 and one in M20-M27.
At least one of M26/M27 is NormalBattle, EliteBattle, Supply or Shop.
Every complete path has at least 8 combat nodes including M19 and M29.
Every complete path has at least 4 combat nodes before M19.
Every complete path has at least 2 combat nodes after M19 and before M29.
No complete path contains more than 2 consecutive non-combat nodes.

deterministicStreams.topology: graybox v0.2 exact rule: skeletons[(uint32(mapSeed) - 1) mod 4], ordered A/B/C/D
deterministicStreams.contentAttempt: port rngFor(seed, imul(attemptIndex + 1, 0x85ebca6b)) from referenceSimulator with exact uint32 overflow semantics

assignmentOrder: pick a third EliteBattle from the remaining M08-M18 or M20-M27
pick one Shop from remaining M08-M18
pick one Shop from remaining M20-M27
shuffle and assign 13 NormalBattle plus 2 each Supply/Event/Rest/Treasure to remaining anchors
validate all path constraints; on failure increment attemptIndex and repeat
contentGeneration.failurePolicy: Do not silently relax constraints. Log seed and reject run creation if no valid assignment is found.

implementationNotes: Art preview types and labels are not runtime assignments except fixed nodes.
Route rendering must use island route ports, never label centers.
M29 has one logical predecessor M28 even if art renders a decorative double-stroke route.
Battle retry keeps the same content assignment, encounter seed and fog combat snapshot.
Boss victory is final before any post-battle fog animation or reward-signature wait.
